heading: Weddings at Sane Living Center
intro:
A beautiful sacred space in the heart of Ojai. Say your vows beneath the stained glass, toast under the olive trees and string lights in the Secret Garden, then dim the lights for dancing in the Auditorium.

Your guests walk from their hotels to the ceremony and on to downtown dinner, and the wedding party gets ready in a private room down the hall. Bring in the vendors you love and make the whole day yours, at one address in the heart of Ojai.
highlights: Amplified music inside the Auditorium; outdoor sound in the Secret Garden wraps up by 10 PM
The Secret Garden also available to rent
The Annex as a private bridal room for getting ready
pricingText: Wedding packages starting at $1,500. Each quote is based on your guest count and needs. Call (805) 646-6000 for a custom quote.
cateringPolicy: Outside caterers are welcome, and you can even have a food truck set up in Sane Living Center's private parking lot. Caterers must provide proof of insurance and follow the venue's load-in, cleanup, and house rules.
alcoholPolicy: Clients are welcome to provide and serve their own alcohol, provided alcohol service is covered under the event’s Certificate of Insurance (COI).
availabilityNote: Purple dates on the calendar are not available.
